items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Me and him worked together up there with Freddie Kepard.

ctx.x: Boy one on his arm, one on his arm, one on his mouth, and two on his back part.

Yeah. He was a kid in his pocket. And boy he played all of them sticks. Was he there before you went up and on? No. Me and him worked together up there with Freddie Kepard. Oh yeah. And he taken sick and dying. Oh yeah. But he had something breaking out on him. Yeah. He's the one I told you to come on the job and say he left something behind me and he can't remember what it is. Uh huh. And he kept on thinking so he said oh that's right it's my teeth. I ain't got my teeth. Uh huh. That's false teeth and he left…
Or before I went to Mexico or after. I think. Or before I went to Mexico. Ask him who was in the band then. You say who was in the band then.
